info.description: API for the Dashboard services, widgets, and user accounts.
info.title: Dashboard API

get.description: Return a pointer to the API catalog.
Return the available services and widgets for dashboard clients.
Return every widget instance placed on the dashboard of the current user, ordered by creation date. Requires the session_id cookie.

200.description: The dashboard widgets of the current user.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session cookie.

post.description: Create a widget instance. The type must use the "service.widget" format (e.g. "sncf.departures"), the size must be allowed for that widget, the refresh rate must be at least 60 seconds, and the position is the zero-based top-left cell on the 6x6 desktop grid. The new widget must fit inside the grid without overlapping an existing widget.

parameters.description: Widget to create (type, size, config, refresh_rate_seconds, position)
parameters.name: widget

400.description: Malformed JSON body or missing type, size, refresh_rate_seconds or position.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session cookie.

404.description: Unknown widget type (unknown service, unknown widget, or malformed type string).

409.description: The new widget overlaps another widget of the dashboard.

422.description: Size not allowed for this widget, refresh rate below 60 seconds, invalid config parameter, or position outside the 6x6 grid.

delete.description: Delete a widget instance from the dashboard of the current user. Only the instance is removed; the widget catalog entry and the other widgets are untouched. Returns an empty body.

400.description: The widget ID is not a valid UUID.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session cookie.

404.description: No widget with this ID on the dashboard of the current user.

patch.description: Update any subset of size, config, refresh rate or position. Omitted fields are left unchanged. The widget type cannot be changed. After applying the patch, the whole dashboard layout is revalidated: the widget must fit inside the 6x6 desktop grid without overlapping another widget.

parameters.description: Fields to update (only non-null fields are applied)
parameters.name: widget

400.description: Malformed widget ID, malformed JSON body, or empty patch (no updatable field provided).

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid session cookie.

404.description: No widget with this ID on the dashboard of the current user.

409.description: The updated widget would overlap another widget of the dashboard.

422.description: Size not allowed for this widget, refresh rate below 60 seconds, invalid config parameter, or position outside the 6x6 grid.

post.description: Returns the next 10 departures (scheduled time, real time, destination, delay in minutes, cancellation flag) for a station. The station name is matched exactly against the SNCF stop_areas catalog. Public route: no authentication required.

parameters.description: Station name exactly as listed in the SNCF catalog (e.g. Paris Gare du Nord)
parameters.name: station

200.description: Up to 10 upcoming departures, earliest first.

400.description: Malformed JSON body or missing/empty text field.

404.description: No station with this exact name in the SNCF catalog.

500.description: Station lookup or SNCF request construction failed.

502.description: SNCF API unreachable, non-2xx response, or invalid payload.

503.description: API_KEY_SNCF is not set on the server.

post.description: Authenticate a user with email and password. On success persists a 7-day session in the database and sets the HTTP-only session_id cookie (SameSite Lax). OAuth-only accounts (no local password) cannot use this route.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, missing fields, or invalid email format.

401.description: Unknown email, wrong password, or account without local password (use OAuth instead).

403.description: Account created but email not confirmed yet (check /confirm).

500.description: Password comparison or session creation failed.

post.description: Delete the current session from the database and clear the HTTP-only session_id cookie. Third-party service tokens (user_services) are kept: disconnecting a service is a separate operation.

200.description: The session was revoked and the cookie cleared.

401.description: Missing session cookie, or expired/invalid session (cookie is cleared).

get.description: Return the id and email of the account associated with the current browser session. Used by the frontend on page load to decide whether to show "Log in" or "Log out". Requires the session_id cookie.

200.description: The id and email of the authenticated user.

401.description: Missing session cookie, or expired/invalid session (cookie is cleared).

post.description: Create a user account with email and password (minimum 8 characters). The account stays unconfirmed until the emailed token is validated via GET /confirm, and login is blocked meanwhile. No session is created here.

parameters.description: Registration credentials (valid email + password of at least 8 characters)
parameters.name: credentials

201.description: Account created: check the inbox for the confirmation email.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, invalid email format, or password shorter than 8 characters.

409.description: This email address is already registered.

500.description: Password hashing, token generation, or account creation failed.

get.description: Start an OAuth authentication flow for a supported provider. Sets two short-lived HTTP-only cookies (OAuth state and session, 10 minutes) then redirects the browser (302) to the provider's consent page. The frontend must navigate to this URL directly (full page load), not via fetch, so cookies and redirects work.

302.description: Redirect to the provider consent page.

404.description: Unknown provider name (only google and github are supported).

500.description: Unable to start OAuth login or to build the provider URL.

get.description: Handle the provider callback: verify the state cookie, exchange the authorization code, fetch the provider profile, then create or retrieve the local user (OAuth accounts are auto-confirmed, no email verification needed). Persists a 7-day session in the database, sets the HTTP-only session_id cookie, and redirects (302) to the frontend dashboard. On failure returns JSON instead of redirecting.

parameters.description: OAuth state returned by the provider (must match the oauth_state_<provider> cookie)
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Authorization code returned by the provider
parameters.name: code

302.description: Authenticated: redirect to the frontend dashboard with the session_id cookie set.

400.description: State mismatch, expired OAuth cookies, or provider returned no email address.

404.description: Unknown provider name (only google and github are supported).

500.description: Local account creation, session persistence, or redirect target failed.

502.description: Code exchange or profile fetch failed at the provider.

get.description: Confirm a user account with the single-use token sent by email (valid 24h). The token is consumed on success; already-confirmed accounts return "already_confirmed". No session is created: log in afterwards via POST /auth/login.

parameters.description: Email confirmation token from the confirmation link
parameters.name: token

410.description: Token older than 24h (request a new one via POST /confirm/resend).

post.description: Rotate the confirmation token of an unconfirmed account and send a new confirmation email. Rate-limited to 3 requests per 15 minutes. Already-confirmed accounts return "already_confirmed".

200.description: New confirmation email queued (or account already confirmed).

400.description: Malformed JSON body or missing token.

404.description: No account matches this token (unknown or already consumed).

500.description: Database error while rotating the token.

get.description: Check whether the API process is responding.
